teaser: Every image model on OpenRouter, eleven briefs, 101 images judged blind, $10.44: which model for which infographic, and what it costs.
core_idea: To make infographics part of the newsroom's workflow, every image-output model on OpenRouter on 10 October 2026 was given the same briefs from one article, from 18 words to 2,800, plus an edit, a component, a brand slide and a deck, over five rounds with blind judging and recorded costs; the answer is to choose the model by the job, not the budget: Nano Banana 2.1 for concept slides, charts and decks, Gemini 3 Pro Image when speed matters, GPT-5.4 Image 2 for documents, edits, components and brand slides, with prompt rules learned from the faults and a style reference for every deck.
